   Sports Clippers vs. Warriors Predictions, Odds & Stats – Nov. 1
 Nov 1, 2026 Photo : Ezra Shaw / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images 
 The Los Angeles Clippers (1-4) are 2.5-point underdogs as they look to stop a four-game losing streak when they visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3) on Sunday, November 1, 2026 at Chase Center. The matchup airs at 8:30 p.m. ET on NBCS-BA, PCK-GSW, and ClipperVision.
 Watch the NBA, other live sports and more on Fubo. What is Fubo? Fubo is a streaming service that gives you access to your favorite live sports and shows on demand. Use our link to sign up.
 Listen to the game on AM 570 LA Sports 
 Clippers vs. Warriors Predictions for Sunday
 Our computer projections model for this contest expects a final result of Warriors 118, Clippers 106.
 Moneyline Pick: Warriors (-131)
 Total Pick: Over 221.5 (computer predicts 224.6 points) 
 Pick ATS: Warriors (-2.5)

 Warriors 2026-27 Betting Trends
 Golden State is 4-2-0 against the spread this season.
 The Warriors are winless against the spread (0-1) when playing as at least 2.5-point favorites.
 Golden State has gone over in three of its five games with a set total (60%).
 The Warriors lost the only game they've played as the favorite this season.
 Golden State has played as a favorite of -131 or more once this season and lost that game.
 Clippers 2026-27 Betting Trends
 Los Angeles is 3-2-0 against the spread this year.
 The Clippers have a 2-1 record against the spread in games they were an underdog by 2.5 points or more this year.
 Los Angeles has gone over in two of five games with a set total.
 The Clippers have not yet won a game they were the moneyline underdog this season, going 3-2.
 Los Angeles has not yet won a game when entering as a moneyline underdog with odds of +110 or longer in three chances.
